title: Changes in European Solidarity Before and During COVID-19: Evidence from a Large Crowd- and Expert-Annotated Twitter Dataset
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on European social and political solidarity.

measurement_description: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures expressions of social and anti-social solidarity in tweets related to European political and social crises (refugee crisis, financial crisis).
